---

## ✋ Read this first

- **What this does:** you write a short movie on one node (who is in it, where it happens, and every shot), make a picture for each person and place, and press **Run**. It renders the shots one after another with MiniMax H3 and joins them into one movie with sound and dialogue.
- **Do the steps in order.** Every step uses what the step before it made. Skipping ahead is the fastest way to get strangers in random rooms.
- **💡 The guided tour:** open **Vision Assistant** (the left sidebar) → **Tour**. It lights up each part of the workflow in order and marks the settings that matter. Use it alongside this note.
- 🛑🚫 **Don't bypass nodes by hand.** Each part has a switch (below).
- ⚠️ This is a **long job** on a **big model**. 32 GB of VRAM is comfortable at 960 x 544. Less works, just slower.

### The basics
- **This workflow saves every step.** 
   - If you create images, video sections, etc., you can 💾 save the project, work on a different project, and come back to it or redo a section at any time.
   -  **Nothing is lost:** what finished stays finished.
- **Switching from step to step:** the **Section Bypasser** panel turns whole parts of the workflow on and off. Only one part runs at a time:
    - **Story Card Prompt**: makes the pictures for your cards (step 2).
    - **Storyboard**: makes the first frame of each shot (step 3).
    - **Make**: renders the movie (step 4).
    - ⚠️ **Make must be off while you make pictures.** A new picture changes the shots that use it, and Make would render them again on the same Run. The bypasser does that automatically.
- **Save💾** Everything is saved in a **project** folder named on the Story node. Close ComfyUI, come back tomorrow, and it's all still there.

**🎨Post processing**
- Leave these switches off until you are ready to use it
- It processes the entire movie all at once and it is heavy, so I would not let it just run.
- **Make** switch needs to be on.

---

## ⚙️ Settings (set once, before step 1)

- **megapixels**: 0.52 = 960 x 544 is the tested size.
   - Keep one size for the whole project; changing it later means making every shot again.
   - 💡 Don't stress too much over quality here. Push out decent, but 1 MP just slows down what you can upscale in the end.
- **Steps**: 8 with the turbo LoRA (Models & LoRAs). More steps without turbo is slower and not better in my tests.
- **LC Seed**: the seed generator is the starting seed for H3 (each new shot) and the storyboard (MOSS and Krea 2: seed + shot number).
   - Every made shot keeps its own seed with its take, and ↻ (remake) always picks a new one.
   - The card pictures and post processing have their own seeds. Leave it alone.
- **Models & LoRAs**: the LC Optimizer picks the H3 files for your card. 
   - I suggest leaving it on **★ Recommended**.
   - I've tested it on other models. 10EROS works well, Singularity has voice issues. 
   - LoRAs. Your mileage will vary. 


---

## Step 1: 🎬 Write the story

Everything happens on the big **LC H3 Story** node. It has five lists: **🎭 Cast**, **👗 Outfits**, **📍 Places**, **👜 Props** and **🎞 Shots**.

- ✋ **The text a shot builds is exactly what H3 gets.** Nothing rewrites it behind your back. Open a shot's preview to read it.
- **project name** (top): the folder everything is saved in, `output/LC_H3/<name>/`. Name it first. **📂** opens a saved project, **💾** saves now (every Run saves too).
- **The look of the whole movie** (top line): a few words for the film style ("cinematic, soft natural light, shallow depth of field"). It goes into every shot.

### ✨ Write the story (optional)
- Type a short pitch ("Nova and Anika meet for coffee, Anika tells a story that goes too far, Nova leaves") and press **✨ Write the story**. A local model fills in the look, cast, places and shots once.
- After that it's plain text you edit. It never writes again unless you press the button again (which replaces the cards; pictures and voices on cards with the same name stay).
- Needs the **Story writer model** above. Pick it in the dropdown next to the button.


### 🎭 Cast: one card per person
- **Name**: start with a capital letter. Shots find people by this exact name.
- **who**: woman, man, girl, boy, person, cat, dog. It tells people apart in the prompt.
- **look**: one line, the words H3 follows most. Describe the head and hair, then stop: age, face, eyes, freckles, skin, hair (length too). "mid twenties, a soft oval face, green eyes, light freckles, long wavy blonde hair". Never clothes: they go in the outfit picture.
- **face picture**: a headshot, made in step 2, or yours (click the square or drop a picture on it). The background is automatically removed and the face is placed on a plain grey background to prevent it from bleeding into the scene or outfit.
    - Headshot means head and hair. No shoulders, no clothes: clothes in a headshot beat every outfit picture.
- **👗 outfit picture**: what they wear from their first shot, head to toe. Made in step 2 (kind **cast card + outfit** makes it and the headshot in one Run), or yours.
    - **outfit notes**: the whole outfit in detail. Only the picture is made from it, H3 never reads it.
- **🎤 voice** (optional): a 2 to 15 s clip of how they sound. H3 copies the voice, not the words.
- **📋** copies the name and look to paste into another workflow.

### 👗 Outfits: the clothes, one card per outfit
- ✋ **Everyone needs clothes from somewhere.** The headshot carries none. Give each person a 👗 outfit picture on their cast card. With none, they get different clothes in every shot, and the Story warns you (👗).
- An outfit card is a change of clothes.
- **name**: a simple name: "red cocktail dress", "yoga outfit", "gym clothes". With a picture, it's all H3 reads about the outfit.
    - Never a list of pieces. Shoes and pants in the words pull close-ups wide (the Story warns you).
- **who wears it**: the person.
- **description**: the whole outfit head to toe, in detail, **a color for every item**, with the shade: "an off the shoulder grey cutoff sweatshirt, high waisted black leggings with a cross stitch band, white Nike gym shoes". Only the picture is made from it.
    - Layers outside first, with "over". Patterns name their colors ("floral blouse in pale peach and green"). Fabric helps (denim, silk, knit, leather).
- **picture**: made in step 2 (kind **outfit**: the person who wears it, head to toe, on plain grey), or yours. It carries every detail the name doesn't say.
- **How it plays:**
    - Everyone starts in their cast card's 👗 outfit. To change, pick another on a shot with **👗**, or name it in the action ("Nova comes back in the red dress"). They stay in it from that shot on.
    - Each shot gets "wearing <name>" in the prompt and the outfit picture. Close-ups stay close: no pants or shoes in the words.
    - Tested: a one-strap red dress with silver details came through from the picture alone, named just "red dress".
    - ⚠️ **Mismatched reference**: a cut back to an earlier camera opens on that shot's first frame, and a wide takes its room from the place's first wide. If that frame shows other clothes, people or props, the Story warns you. Pin a start frame, or give the scene its own place card.

### 📍 Places: one card per location
- **name**: "the cafe". Shots pick their place by this name.
- **sound**: the room tone, "soft cafe chatter, cups clinking".
- **description**: what is there: the room, the furniture, the light.
- **room picture**: the place, **empty**. Made in step 2, or yours.
- **🌐 360** (recommended): **one** panorama of the whole room (step 2). You don't make a picture per shot: the Story cuts each shot's view out of it by itself.
    - **Set it once:** turn the small viewer under the place until it shows what your wide shot shows (**📷 the wide shot faces**). That is "front". Every angle counts from there: 90 = right side of the room, -90 = left, 180 = behind the camera.
    - **Close-ups and medium shots get their view automatically.** One across the table from someone who already has an angle gets the reverse angle (+180), so the two of them have opposite sides of the room behind them. The others face the way the wide shot faces.
    - **Want a different angle?** Press **🌐** on the shot card and drag the view. Your angle always wins over the automatic one.
    - The view is cut as a flat picture (in the project's `views/` folder) and used as that shot's background, by Make and by the storyboard.
    - Wide shots use the room picture and the anchor, unless you aim them with 🌐 too.
- **📌 anchors**: frames that keep this room the same across cuts. Empty at first: see **📌 Anchors** below.

### 👜 Props: one card per object that matters
- Only for an object that must look the same in every shot (the red umbrella, the letter, the ring).
- **name**: "the red umbrella". ✋ Use these **exact words** in a shot's action, and that shot gets the prop's picture.
- **description**: what it looks like.
- **picture**: made in step 2 (kind **prop**), or yours. It goes on plain grey like the cast.


**💡 Need something simple?** 
- Every cast, outfit, prop and 🌐 360 slot has a 📚 Library tab in its picture picker: 102 ready-made pictures (30 cast headshots, 32 seasonal outfits, 24 props, 16 360 panoramas). Browse them all: [LC H3 Library on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lonecatone23/lc-h3-library)


### 🎞 Shots: one card per shot, top to bottom is the movie
- **framing**: how close the camera is.
    - **wide shot**: the whole room and everyone in it. Start a scene with one.
    - **side view**, **two-shot**: two people in frame.
    - **medium shot**: waist up. **close-up**: face and shoulders. **extreme close-up**: the face.
    - **over the shoulder**, **from behind**, **custom** (you describe it in the action).
- **who it's on**: the person the camera is on (or everyone).
- **move**: still, slow push-in, slow pull back, pan, tracking, orbit, handheld. Still is the safest.
- **✂ cut / 🎞 keep rolling**:
    - **cut**: a new shot. It gets the faces, the room and the anchor. Use it almost always.
    - **keep rolling**: no cut, the camera carries straight on from the end of the shot before. It gets **no pictures**, only the frames it carries on from.
    - ⚠️ Keep rolling only works with the **same framing** in the **same place**. Change the framing and it's made as a cut, or H3 cuts by itself to a room it invents.
- **where**: the place. Empty = the same place as the shot before.
- **seconds**: empty (**auto**) fits the action and the line. Type a number to set it. A line that can't fit stretches the shot.
- **action**: what happens before the line. Short sentences, present tense, one thing each.
- **speaker** + **line**: who talks, and the words exactly as they say them. One line per shot.
- **after**: what happens after the line (optional).
- **🌐** (optional): aim this shot's camera inside the place's 360 panorama yourself. Close-ups get an angle automatically; this overrides it. **behind** is what is behind the person in words ("the arched windows"). H3 follows words over pictures, so fill it in.
- **🖼 start** / **🏁 end**: the first or last frame of the shot (step 3, or yours). H3 copies a start frame exactly.
- **📐**: draw boxes for who stands where (and props). The storyboard uses them in step 3.
- **🔗 Check the join** (keep-rolling shots only): looks at how the shot before really ended and suggests an action that carries on from there.
- The preview under each card shows exactly what H3 gets, and the **warnings** (🛑 must fix, ⚠️ should look at).
- **max_shot_seconds** (on the node, 20): the longest shot made in one go. Longer shots are made in parts that carry on from each other.

---

## ✍️ Prompting:
### 📖 **The full guide:** [H3 Showrunner Prompting Guide](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes/blob/main/assets/H3_Showrunner_Prompting_Guide.md)

### The short version:

- **Looks**: one line each, head and hair only. Say the hair length, or H3 picks one.
- **Outfits**: a simple name on the card ("gym clothes"). The details go in its description, a color with a shade for every item: "faded olive jacket over a cream t-shirt".
- **Close-ups**: don't name the other person in the action. "Anika stares at Nova" made H3 cut to Nova halfway through Anika's close-up. "Anika stares across the table" kept her the whole shot. The Story warns you (⚠️).
- **Count props once**: "Each of them holds one cup." Or extras show up.
- **Name the prop like its card**: the card says "the red umbrella", the action says "Nova opens the red umbrella."
- **Close-ups across a table**: "Seen straight on from across the table, nobody in the foreground: the table edge runs along the bottom of the frame, her body square to the camera, eyes just past the lens to the left." Then say what is behind her.
- **No mouth actions during a line**: drinking or eating while talking loses the lips. The Story puts the cups down for you, but write the sip after the line.
- **Say what happens, not what doesn't**: "Nova sits still and listens", not "Nova doesn't move".

---

## Step 2: 📸 Make the pictures

- 🔀 **Story Card Prompt** on, **Make** off. Run once per picture.
- On **LC H3 Story Card Prompt**, pick the **kind** and type the card's **name** (blank = the first card of that kind):
    - **cast card**: a headshot from the look: head and hair, calm neutral face, no clothes, on plain grey.
    - **cast card + outfit**: the headshot and the 👗 outfit picture (the person head to toe, from the outfit notes) in one Run.
    - **cast outfit**: just the 👗 outfit picture.
    - **outfit**: an outfit card's description on the person who wears it, head to toe, on plain grey (an invisible mannequin when nobody wears it).
    - **place**: the room, empty, the whole space in view.
    - **360 panorama**: the room all the way round (2:1) for the 🌐 slot.
    - **prop**: the object alone, on plain grey.
- The picture lands on its card by itself. A new picture never writes over an old one.
- ✋ **Cast, outfit and prop pictures always end up on plain grey**: drafted here or dropped in yourself, the background comes off (BiRefNet). A card's own background, props and expression leak into every shot it's in.
- 💡 Not happy? Run again: the seed changes every Run. The last one made is the one on the card.
- 💡 **Neutral faces only.** A smiling card gives you a smiling actor in every shot. It's not a hard lock, but it pulls.
- 💡 **360 panorama**: one per place. Make a few and keep one with a level horizon and nobody in it, then set **📷 the wide shot faces** on the place card once.
- 📚 **Or skip making them:** every cast, outfit, prop and 🌐 360 slot has a **📚 Library** tab in its picture picker: 102 ready-made pictures (30 cast headshots, 32 seasonal outfits, 24 props, 16 360 panoramas).
    - Click one: it downloads once and lands on the card. An empty card gets its name and text too.
    - Browse them all: [LC H3 Library on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lonecatone23/lc-h3-library)

---

## Step 3: 🗺️ Storyboard (optional, recommended)

The first frame of each shot, built from your cards, so every shot starts with the right people in the right room.

- 🔀 **Storyboard** on, **Make** off.
- On each shot card, press **📐** and draw a box for each person (and prop) where they should be. Pick who each box is.
- Run. **MOSS** lays the shot out from the boxes, then **Krea 2 Identity Edit** redraws it sharp with your cast cards. It lands in the shot's **🖼 start** slot.
- Leave **shot** blank and every Run fills the next shot still missing its start frame. One Run per shot.
- A later wide shot in a place you've already shown is built from the first wide shot's frame, so the room, the table and the camera side stay put.
    - ✋ **Box only who changes** (Nova coming back in the red dress). Everyone boxed is drawn again, and their face can drift.
- ✋ **The start frame is the action's first moment.** Nova already seated in the frame + "Nova comes back and sits down" gave a second Nova walking in. Box her where she comes from, or write the action from where the frame is.
- ✋ **H3 copies a start frame exactly.** A soft or wrong picture makes a soft or wrong shot. ↻ on the slot empties it and the next Run makes it again.

---

## Step 4: 🎥 Make the movie

- 🔀 **Make** on, the picture parts off. Press **Run** once.
- One Run makes the whole movie, shot after shot, and joins it as it goes. 1 shot or 20.
- **Stop** ends it with nothing left in the queue. Run again and it picks up where it stopped.
- **The board** (under the shots on the Story node):
    - ✅ made, ✏️ changed since it was made, 🔒 locked.
    - ▶ plays a shot. ↻ makes it again with a new seed (the old take is kept in `takes/`). 🔒 locks a keeper so nothing remakes it.
    - 🎬 plays the whole movie.
- **Changed a shot?** It turns ✏️. Run remakes only the ✏️ shots, the rest stay.
- **info** (Make's text output) after every shot:
    - **face match**: 0.55 and up = same person, 0.40 to 0.55 = close, under 0.40 = someone else. Redo it.
    - **join**: how smooth each keep-rolling join is.

### 📌 Anchors: keeping the room the same
- **What it is:** a still frame of a place, saved on the place card's **📌 anchors** row. It shows H3 the room as it must stay: the furniture, the windows, who sits where.
- **Why:** on every cut H3 builds the room again. Without something to copy, the café gets a new counter, the table moves, and people swap seats.
- **Automatic** (Make's **hold_scene** on, the default): the first wide shot made in a place becomes its anchor. Every later cut there with **two or more people** gets it. A close-up of one person gets the room picture or its 360 view instead.
- **Your own** (better): play a made shot on the board (▶), pause on a frame where the room and everyone in it look right, press **📌**. It lands in that place's anchors row and replaces the automatic one. The **+** square in the row takes any picture.
- **Cutting back** to a setup you've already shown (same place, framing and person) opens on that shot's first frame by itself, so the camera, room and people match. Remake the first one and the cut-back is marked ✏️ too.
- Keep-rolling shots never get an anchor: they carry on from the frames before them.
- A storyboard start frame (step 3) beats an anchor: H3 copies it exactly. Anchors matter most for shots without one.
- × on an anchor removes it.

---

## Step 5: 🎞️ Post Processing (when the movie is done)

### ⚠️ It will not save unless **Save Video 💾** is switched on!
- Keep **Make** on: with every shot made it just hands over the finished movie. Nothing renders again.
- Turn on what you want in the panel, in this order:
    - **Load Video**: needed for everything below.
    - **VOSR2 2x**: the most detail in my tests, about 16 minutes for a 25 s movie.
    - **Frame Interpolate** 24 → 48: about half the jitter for a sliver of detail. Under a minute.
    - **RTX Super Resolution**: **deblur** after VOSR2 crisps the edges. 
    - **Film Grain**: 0.25 is a light film texture.

---

## ✋ 先读这里

- **它能做什么：** 你在一个节点上写一部短片（谁出场、在哪里发生、每一个镜头），为每个人物和地点做一张图片，然后按 **Run**。它用 MiniMax H3 一个接一个地渲染镜头，再拼成一部带声音和对白的影片。
- **按顺序做每一步。** 每一步都要用到上一步做出的东西。跳步是让陌生人出现在随机房间里的最快办法。
- **💡 导览：** 打开 **Vision Assistant**（左侧边栏）→ **Tour**。它会按顺序点亮工作流的每个部分，并标出重要的设置。和这份说明一起用。
- 🛑🚫 **不要手动绕过节点。** 每个部分都有开关（见下文）。
- ⚠️ 这是用**大模型**跑的**长任务**。960 x 544 下 32 GB 的 VRAM 比较宽裕。更少也能跑，只是更慢。

### 基础
- **这个工作流会保存每一步。**
   - 如果你做了图片、视频片段等，可以 💾 保存项目，去做别的项目，随时回来继续或重做某个部分。
   -  **什么都不会丢：** 做完的就是做完了。
- **在步骤之间切换：** **Section Bypasser** 面板可以整块打开或关闭工作流的各个部分。一次只运行一个部分：
    - **Story Card Prompt**：为你的卡片做图片（第 2 步）。
    - **Storyboard**：为每个镜头做第一帧（第 3 步）。
    - **Make**：渲染影片（第 4 步）。
    - ⚠️ **做图片时 Make 必须关闭。** 新图片会改变用到它的镜头，Make 会在同一次 Run 里把它们重新渲染。bypasser 会自动处理这一点。
- **保存💾** 所有内容都保存在 Story 节点上命名的**项目**文件夹里。关掉 ComfyUI，明天再回来，东西都还在。

**🎨后期处理**
- 准备好用之前，先把这些开关关着
- 它一次处理整部影片，很吃资源，所以我不会让它就这么跟着跑。
- **Make** 开关需要打开。

## ⚙️ 设置（第 1 步之前设一次）

- **megapixels**：0.52 = 960 x 544，是测试过的尺寸。
   - 整个项目保持同一个尺寸；之后再改就要重做每个镜头。
   - 💡 不用太纠结这里的画质。出得还行就够了，1 MP 只会拖慢速度，而这些最后都可以放大。
- **Steps**：配合 turbo LoRA 用 8（见 Models & LoRAs）。不用 turbo、加更多步数更慢，在我的测试里也没有更好。
- **LC Seed**：种子生成器是 H3（每个新镜头）和故事板（MOSS 和 Krea 2：seed + 镜头编号）的起始种子。

   - 卡片图片和后期处理有自己的种子。不用管它。
- **Models & LoRAs**：LC Optimizer 为你的显卡挑选 H3 文件。
   - 我建议保持 **★ Recommended**。
   - 我在其他模型上也测试过。10EROS 效果不错，Singularity 有声音问题。

## 第 1 步：🎬 写故事

所有事都在大大的 **LC H3 Story** 节点上完成。它有五个列表：**🎭 Cast**（角色）、**👗 Outfits**（服装）、**📍 Places**（地点）、**👜 Props**（道具）和 **🎞 Shots**（镜头）。

- ✋ **镜头生成的文本就是 H3 收到的全部内容。** 不会有东西在背后改写它。打开镜头的预览就能读到。
- **project name**（顶部）：保存所有内容的文件夹，`output/LC_H3/<name>/`。先给它起名。**📂** 打开已保存的项目，**💾** 立即保存（每次 Run 也会保存）。
- **整部影片的风格**（顶部那一行）：几个描述影片风格的词（"cinematic, soft natural light, shallow depth of field"）。它会进入每个镜头。

### ✨ Write the story（写故事，可选）
- 输入一段简短的梗概（"Nova and Anika meet for coffee, Anika tells a story that goes too far, Nova leaves"），然后按 **✨ Write the story**。本地模型会一次性填好风格、角色、地点和镜头。
- 之后它就是你自己编辑的纯文本。除非你再按一次按钮，它不会再写（再按会替换卡片；同名卡片上的图片和声音会保留）。
- 需要上面的 **Story writer 模型**。在按钮旁边的下拉菜单里选它。

### 🎭 Cast：每个人一张卡
- **Name**：首字母大写。镜头靠这个名字精确地找到人。
- **who**：woman, man, girl, boy, person, cat, dog。它让提示词里的人互相区分开。
- **look**：一行，是 H3 最听从的词。写头部和头发，然后就停：年龄、脸、眼睛、雀斑、皮肤、发型（包括长度）。"mid twenties, a soft oval face, green eyes, light freckles, long wavy blonde hair"。绝不写衣服：衣服放在服装图片里。
- **face picture**：一张头像，在第 2 步做，或者用你自己的（点方框或把图片拖上去）。背景会自动去掉，脸会放在纯灰背景上，防止背景渗进场景或服装里。
    - 头像指的是头和头发。不要肩膀，不要衣服：头像里的衣服会压过所有服装图片。
- **👗 outfit picture**：他们从第一个镜头起穿的衣服，从头到脚。在第 2 步做（kind **cast card + outfit** 一次 Run 同时做出它和头像），或者用你自己的。
    - **outfit notes**：整套服装的详细描述。只用来生成图片，H3 从不读它。
- **🎤 voice**（可选）：一段 2 到 15 秒、能听出他们声音的录音。H3 复制的是声音，不是说的内容。
- **📋** 复制名字和 look，可以粘贴到别的工作流里。

### 👗 Outfits：衣服，每套服装一张卡
- ✋ **每个人的衣服都得有个来源。** 头像不带衣服。给每个人的角色卡配一张 👗 服装图片。没有的话，他们每个镜头都会穿不同的衣服，Story 会警告你（👗）。
- 服装卡就是换一套衣服。
- **name**：一个简单的名字："red cocktail dress"、"yoga outfit"、"gym clothes"。有图片的话，H3 对这套服装读到的就只有它。
    - 不要写成一串单品。词里写鞋子和裤子会把 close-up 拉成远景（Story 会警告你）。
- **who wears it**：穿它的人。
- **description**：整套服装从头到脚的详细描述，**每件都写颜色**，包括深浅："an off the shoulder grey cutoff sweatshirt, high waisted black leggings with a cross stitch band, white Nike gym shoes"。只用来生成图片。
    - 分层从最外面写起，用 "over"。图案要写出颜色（"floral blouse in pale peach and green"）。写上面料有帮助（denim, silk, knit, leather）。
- **picture**：在第 2 步做（kind **outfit**：穿它的人，从头到脚，纯灰背景），或者用你自己的。它带有名字没说的每个细节。
- **实际效果：**
    - 每个人一开始都穿角色卡的 👗 服装。要换装，就在某个镜头上选另一套 **👗**，或者在 action 里写出它（"Nova comes back in the red dress"）。他们从那个镜头起一直穿着。
    - 每个镜头的提示词里会加上 "wearing <name>"，并带上服装图片。Close-up 保持 close-up：词里不要有裤子或鞋子。
    - 测试过：一条带银色细节的单肩红裙，只靠图片就还原了出来，名字只写了 "red dress"。
    - ⚠️ **Mismatched reference**：切回到之前的某个机位时，会从那个镜头的第一帧开始，wide shot 的房间取自该地点的第一个 wide。如果那一帧里出现了别的衣服、人或道具，Story 会警告你。固定一个 start frame，或者给这个场景单独做一张地点卡。

### 📍 Places：每个地点一张卡
- **name**："the cafe"。镜头靠这个名字选地点。
- **sound**：环境音，"soft cafe chatter, cups clinking"。
- **description**：里面有什么：房间、家具、光线。
- **room picture**：这个地点，**空无一人**。在第 2 步做，或者用你自己的。
- **🌐 360**（推荐）：整个房间的**一张**全景图（第 2 步）。你不用为每个镜头做图：Story 会自己从里面裁出每个镜头的视角。
    - **设一次就行：** 转动地点下面的小预览器，直到它显示的就是你的 wide shot 看到的画面（**📷 the wide shot faces**）。那就是"正前方"。所有角度都从这里算：90 = 房间右侧，-90 = 左侧，180 = 摄影机背后。
    - **Close-up 和 medium shot 会自动得到视角。** 隔着桌子拍、而对面那个人已经有角度时，会得到反打角度（+180），这样两人身后是房间相对的两侧。其他镜头朝向 wide shot 的方向。
    - **想要别的角度？** 在镜头卡上按 **🌐** 拖动视角。你的角度永远优先于自动角度。
    - 视角会裁成一张平面图片（在项目的 `views/` 文件夹里），作为那个镜头的背景，Make 和故事板都会用。
    - Wide shot 用房间图片和 anchor，除非你也用 🌐 去对准它们。
- **📌 anchors**：让这个房间在切镜之间保持一致的帧。一开始是空的：见下面的 **📌 Anchors**。

### 👜 Props：每个重要物件一张卡
- 只用于每个镜头里都必须一样的物件（红伞、信、戒指）。
- **name**："the red umbrella"。✋ 在镜头的 action 里用**完全相同的词**，那个镜头就会拿到道具图片。
- **description**：它的样子。
- **picture**：在第 2 步做（kind **prop**），或者用你自己的。和角色一样放在纯灰背景上。

### 🎞 Shots：每个镜头一张卡，从上到下就是影片
- **framing**：摄影机有多近。
    - **wide shot**：整个房间和里面所有人。用它开始一场戏。
    - **side view**、**two-shot**：画面里两个人。
    - **medium shot**：腰部以上。**close-up**：脸和肩膀。**extreme close-up**：脸。
    - **over the shoulder**、**from behind**、**custom**（在 action 里自己描述）。
- **who it's on**：摄影机对着的人（或所有人）。
- **move**：still, slow push-in, slow pull back, pan, tracking, orbit, handheld。still 最稳。
- **✂ cut / 🎞 keep rolling**：
    - **cut**：新镜头。它会拿到人脸、房间和 anchor。几乎都用它。
    - **keep rolling**：不切，摄影机直接从上一个镜头的结尾接着拍。它**不拿任何图片**，只拿它接续的那些帧。
    - ⚠️ keep rolling 只在**同一 framing**、**同一地点**时才有效。换了 framing 就会按 cut 来做，不然 H3 会自己切到一个它编出来的房间。
- **where**：地点。留空 = 和上一个镜头同一个地点。
- **seconds**：留空（**auto**）会配合 action 和台词。输入数字就固定时长。放不下的台词会把镜头拉长。
- **action**：台词之前发生的事。短句、现在时、每句一件事。
- **speaker** + **line**：谁说话，以及他们说的原话。每个镜头一句台词。
- **after**：台词之后发生的事（可选）。
- **🌐**（可选）：自己在地点的 360 全景里对准这个镜头的摄影机。close-up 会自动得到角度；这个会覆盖它。**behind** 是用文字写出这个人身后有什么（"the arched windows"）。H3 听文字多过看图片，所以要填上。
- **🖼 start** / **🏁 end**：镜头的第一帧或最后一帧（第 3 步，或者用你自己的）。H3 会原样复制 start 帧。
- **📐**：画框决定谁站在哪里（还有道具）。故事板在第 3 步会用到。
- **🔗 Check the join**（只限 keep rolling 镜头）：查看上一个镜头实际是怎么结束的，并建议一个从那里接下去的 action。
- 每张卡下面的预览准确显示 H3 收到的内容，还有**警告**（🛑 必须修，⚠️ 应该看看）。
- **max_shot_seconds**（在节点上，20）：一次做出的最长镜头。更长的镜头会分成几段，一段接一段地做。

## ✍️ 提示词：
### 📖 **完整指南：** [H3 Showrunner 提示词指南](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes/blob/main/assets/H3_Showrunner_Prompting_Guide.md)

### 简短版：

- **Looks**：每人一行，只写头和头发。写明头发长度，不然 H3 会自己挑。
- **Outfits**：卡片上用简单的名字（"gym clothes"）。细节写在 description 里，每件都写带深浅的颜色："faded olive jacket over a cream t-shirt"。
- **Close-up**：不要在 action 里写另一个人的名字。"Anika stares at Nova" 让 H3 在 Anika 的 close-up 拍到一半时切到了 Nova。"Anika stares across the table" 让整个镜头都停在她身上。Story 会警告你（⚠️）。
- **道具只数一次**："Each of them holds one cup." 不然会多出来。
- **道具名和卡片一致**：卡片写 "the red umbrella"，action 就写 "Nova opens the red umbrella."
- **隔着桌子的 close-up**："Seen straight on from across the table, nobody in the foreground: the table edge runs along the bottom of the frame, her body square to the camera, eyes just past the lens to the left." 然后写她身后有什么。
- **说台词时不要有嘴部动作**：边说话边喝或吃会丢掉口型。Story 会帮你把杯子放下，但喝一口要写在台词之后。
- **写发生了什么，不写没发生什么**："Nova sits still and listens"，不要写 "Nova doesn't move"。

## 第 2 步：📸 做图片

- 🔀 **Story Card Prompt** 打开，**Make** 关闭。每张图片 Run 一次。
- 在 **LC H3 Story Card Prompt** 上选 **kind**，输入卡片的 **name**（留空 = 这种类型的第一张卡）：
    - **cast card**：根据 look 生成的头像：头和头发，平静的中性表情，不带衣服，纯灰背景。
    - **cast card + outfit**：一次 Run 同时做出头像和 👗 服装图片（这个人从头到脚，根据 outfit notes）。
    - **cast outfit**：只做 👗 服装图片。
    - **outfit**：服装卡的 description 穿在穿它的人身上，从头到脚，纯灰背景（没人穿它时用隐形人台）。
    - **place**：房间，空无一人，整个空间都在画面里。
    - **360 panorama**：房间一整圈（2:1），用于 🌐 槽位。
    - **prop**：物件单独出现，纯灰背景。
- 图片会自己落到它的卡片上。新图片永远不会覆盖旧图片。
- ✋ **角色、服装和道具图片最终都会在纯灰背景上**：无论是这里生成的还是你自己拖进去的，背景都会被去掉（BiRefNet）。卡片自带的背景、道具和表情会渗进它出现的每个镜头。
- 💡 不满意？再 Run 一次：每次 Run 种子都会变。最后做出来的那张就是卡片上的。
- 💡 **只用中性表情。** 卡片上在笑，每个镜头里的演员都会笑。这不是硬锁定，但会往那边拉。
- 💡 **360 panorama**：每个地点一张。多做几张，留一张地平线水平、没有人的，然后在地点卡上设一次 **📷 the wide shot faces**。
- 📚 **或者不用自己做：** 每个角色、服装、道具和 🌐 360 图片槽的选图窗口里都有 **📚 Library** 标签：102 张现成的图片（30 张角色头像、32 套四季服装、24 个道具、16 张 360 全景）。
    - 点一张：只下载一次，然后直接放到卡片上。空卡片还会自动填好名字和文字。
    - 全部浏览：[Hugging Face 上的 LC H3 Library](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lonecatone23/lc-h3-library)

---

## 第 3 步：🗺️ Storyboard（可选，推荐）

每个镜头的第一帧，用你的卡片搭出来，这样每个镜头一开始就是对的人在对的房间里。

- 🔀 **Storyboard** 打开，**Make** 关闭。
- 在每张镜头卡上按 **📐**，在每个人（和道具）应该在的位置画一个框。选好每个框是谁。
- Run。**MOSS** 按框排好镜头布局，然后 **Krea 2 Identity Edit** 用你的角色卡把它重新画清楚。结果会落到镜头的 **🖼 start** 槽位。
- **shot** 留空，每次 Run 都会填下一个还缺 start 帧的镜头。每个镜头 Run 一次。
- 在已经出现过的地点里，之后的 wide shot 会以第一个 wide shot 的帧为基础来搭，所以房间、桌子和摄影机那一侧都不变。
    - ✋ **只框出有变化的人**（Nova 换上红裙子回来）。每个被框的人都会重画，脸可能会跑偏。
- ✋ **start 帧就是 action 的第一个瞬间。** 帧里 Nova 已经坐着 + "Nova comes back and sits down"，结果出现了第二个 Nova 走进来。把她框在她过来的地方，或者按帧里的状态来写 action。
- ✋ **H3 会原样复制 start 帧。** 图片糊或不对，镜头就糊或不对。槽位上的 ↻ 会清空它，下一次 Run 会重做。

---

## 第 4 步：🎥 做影片

- 🔀 **Make** 打开，做图片的部分关闭。按一次 **Run**。
- 一次 Run 做完整部影片，一个镜头接一个，边做边拼。1 个镜头还是 20 个都一样。
- **Stop** 会结束它，队列里什么都不留。再 Run 一次就从停下的地方继续。
- **分镜板**（Story 节点上镜头的下方）：
    - ✅ 已做好，✏️ 做好后改过，🔒 已锁定。
    - ▶ 播放一个镜头。↻ 用新种子重做（旧的 take 保留在 `takes/`）。🔒 锁住满意的镜头，这样不会被重做。
    - 🎬 播放整部影片。
- **改了某个镜头？** 它会变成 ✏️。Run 只会重做 ✏️ 的镜头，其余保持不变。
- **info**（Make 的文本输出）每个镜头之后会显示：
    - **face match**：0.55 以上 = 同一个人，0.40 到 0.55 = 接近，低于 0.40 = 换了个人。重做。
    - **join**：每个 keep rolling 衔接有多顺。

### 📌 Anchors：让房间保持一致
- **它是什么：** 一个地点的静帧，保存在地点卡的 **📌 anchors** 那一行。它让 H3 看到房间必须保持的样子：家具、窗户、谁坐在哪里。
- **为什么：** 每次 cut，H3 都会重新搭房间。没有东西可以照着做的话，咖啡馆会换个新吧台，桌子会移动，人会换座位。
- **自动**（Make 的 **hold_scene** 打开，默认）：在一个地点做出的第一个 wide shot 会成为它的 anchor。之后在那里**两人或以上**的 cut 都会用到它。单人 close-up 则用房间图片或它的 360 视角。
- **你自己选**（更好）：在分镜板上播放一个做好的镜头（▶），停在房间和里面所有人都对的那一帧，按 **📌**。它会落到那个地点的 anchors 行里，并替换自动的那个。行里的 **+** 方框可以放任何图片。
- **切回**已经出现过的机位（同一地点、framing 和人物）时，会自动从那个镜头的第一帧开始，这样摄影机、房间和人物都对得上。重做第一个镜头，切回的镜头也会被标成 ✏️。
- keep rolling 镜头永远不拿 anchor：它们从前面的帧接下去。
- 故事板的 start 帧（第 3 步）优先于 anchor：H3 会原样复制它。anchor 对没有 start 帧的镜头最重要。
- anchor 上的 × 会删除它。

---

## 第 5 步：🎞️ 后期处理（影片做完之后）

### ⚠️ 不打开 **Save Video 💾** 就不会保存！
- 保持 **Make** 打开：所有镜头都做好时，它只是把成片交出来。不会重新渲染任何东西。
- 在面板里按这个顺序打开你想要的：
    - **Load Video**：下面所有东西都需要它。
    - **VOSR2 2x**：我测试里细节最多，25 秒影片大约 16 分钟。
    - **Frame Interpolate** 24 → 48：抖动大约减半，只损失一点点细节。一分钟以内。
    - **RTX Super Resolution**：在 VOSR2 之后用 **deblur** 让边缘更锐利。
    - **Film Grain**：0.25 是轻微的胶片质感。

## ✋ まずこれを読んでください

- **ステップは順番どおりに。** 各ステップは前のステップで作ったものを使います。飛ばすと、知らない人が適当な部屋にいる映像への最短ルートです。
- **💡 ガイドツアー：** **Vision Assistant**（左のサイドバー）→ **Tour** を開いてください。ワークフローの各部分を順番にハイライトし、大事な設定に印を付けます。このノートと一緒に使ってください。
- 🛑🚫 **ノードを手動でバイパスしないでください。** 各部分には専用のスイッチがあります（下記）。
- ⚠️ これは**大きなモデル**での**長時間のジョブ**です。960 x 544 なら VRAM 32 GB で余裕があります。それ以下でも動きますが、遅くなります。

### 基本
- **このワークフローはすべてのステップを保存します。**
   - 画像や動画のセクションなどを作ったら、💾 プロジェクトを保存して別のプロジェクトで作業し、いつでも戻ってきたり、セクションをやり直したりできます。
   -  **何も失われません：** 完成したものは完成したままです。
- **ステップの切り替え：** **Section Bypasser** パネルでワークフローの各部分をまとめてオン/オフします。一度に動くのは 1 つだけです：
    - **Story Card Prompt**：カードの画像を作ります（ステップ 2）。
    - **Storyboard**：各ショットの最初のフレームを作ります（ステップ 3）。
    - **Make**：映画をレンダリングします（ステップ 4）。
    - ⚠️ **画像を作っている間は Make をオフに。** 新しい画像はそれを使うショットを変えるので、Make が同じ Run でそれらをもう一度レンダリングしてしまいます。バイパサーが自動でそうしてくれます。
- **保存💾** すべては Story ノードで名前を付けた**プロジェクト**フォルダに保存されます。ComfyUI を閉じて明日戻ってきても、全部そのまま残っています。

**🎨Post processing（後処理）**
- 使う準備ができるまで、これらのスイッチはオフのままに
- 映画全体を一度に処理するので重く、私なら放っておいて勝手に走らせたりしません。
- **Make** のスイッチはオンにしておく必要があります。

## ⚙️ Settings（ステップ 1 の前に一度だけ設定）

- **megapixels**：0.52 = 960 x 544 がテスト済みのサイズです。

   - 💡 ここで品質を気にしすぎないでください。そこそこで出しておけば十分で、1 MP は最後にアップスケールできるものを遅くするだけです。
- **Steps**：turbo LoRA（Models & LoRAs）で 8。turbo なしでステップを増やしても遅くなるだけで、私のテストでは良くなりませんでした。
- **LC Seed**：シードジェネレーターは H3（新しいショットごと）とストーリーボード（MOSS と Krea 2：seed + ショット番号）の開始シードです。
   - 作ったショットはテイクごとに自分のシードを保持し、↻（作り直し）は常に新しいシードを選びます。
   - カードの画像と後処理には独自のシードがあります。触らないでください。
- **Models & LoRAs**：LC Optimizer があなたのカードに合った H3 のファイルを選びます。
   - **★ Recommended** のままにするのがおすすめです。
   - 他のモデルでもテストしました。10EROS はうまく動き、Singularity は声に問題があります。
   - LoRA は、結果は人それぞれです。


---

## ステップ 1：🎬 ストーリーを書く

すべては大きな **LC H3 Story** ノードで行います。5 つのリストがあります：**🎭 Cast**、**👗 Outfits**、**📍 Places**、**👜 Props**、**🎞 Shots**。

- ✋ **ショットが組み立てるテキストが、そのまま H3 に渡ります。** 裏で書き換えられることはありません。ショットのプレビューを開くと読めます。
- **project name**（上部）：すべてが保存されるフォルダ `output/LC_H3/<name>/`。最初に名前を付けてください。**📂** で保存したプロジェクトを開き、**💾** で今すぐ保存します（Run のたびにも保存されます）。
- **映画全体のルック**（一番上の行）：映像スタイルを数語で（"cinematic, soft natural light, shallow depth of field"）。すべてのショットに入ります。

### ✨ ストーリーを書く（任意）
- 短いあらすじを入力して（"Nova and Anika meet for coffee, Anika tells a story that goes too far, Nova leaves"）**✨ Write the story** を押します。ローカルモデルがルック、キャスト、場所、ショットを一度だけ埋めます。
- その後はあなたが編集するただのテキストです。もう一度ボタンを押さない限り、二度と書き込みません（押すとカードが置き換わります。同じ名前のカードの画像と声は残ります）。
- 上の **Story writer model** が必要です。ボタンの横のドロップダウンで選んでください。

### 🎭 Cast：1 人につき 1 枚のカード
- **Name**：大文字で始めてください。ショットはこの名前そのままで人物を探します。
- **who**：woman、man、girl、boy、person、cat、dog。プロンプトの中で人物を区別します。
- **look**：1 行で、H3 が一番よく従う言葉です。頭と髪だけを書いて、そこで止めてください：年齢、顔、目、そばかす、肌、髪（長さも）。"mid twenties, a soft oval face, green eyes, light freckles, long wavy blonde hair"。服は絶対に書かないでください：服は outfit picture に入ります。
- **face picture**：ステップ 2 で作ったヘッドショット、または自分の画像（四角をクリックするか、画像をドロップ）。背景は自動で取り除かれ、顔は無地のグレーの背景に置かれるので、シーンや衣装ににじみ出ません。
    - ヘッドショットは頭と髪だけです。肩も服もなし：ヘッドショットに服が入ると、どの outfit picture よりも優先されてしまいます。
- **👗 outfit picture**：最初のショットから着ている服を、頭からつま先まで。ステップ 2 で作るか（kind **cast card + outfit** ならヘッドショットと一緒に 1 回の Run で作れます）、自分の画像。
    - **outfit notes**：衣装全体の詳細。画像を作るためだけに使われ、H3 がこれを読むことはありません。
- **🎤 voice**（任意）：その人の声の 2 から 15 秒のクリップ。H3 は声をまねますが、言葉はまねません。
- **📋** で名前と look をコピーして、別のワークフローに貼り付けられます。

### 👗 Outfits：服、衣装 1 つにつき 1 枚のカード
- ✋ **全員、どこかから服をもらう必要があります。** ヘッドショットには服がありません。各人のキャストカードに 👗 outfit picture を付けてください。ないと、ショットごとに違う服になり、Story が警告します（👗）。
- 衣装カードは着替えです。
- **name**：シンプルな名前で："red cocktail dress"、"yoga outfit"、"gym clothes"。画像があれば、H3 が衣装について読むのはこれだけです。
    - パーツの羅列は絶対にしないでください。言葉に靴やパンツがあると、クローズアップが引きになってしまいます（Story が警告します）。
- **who wears it**：着る人。
- **description**：頭からつま先までの衣装全体を詳しく、**すべてのアイテムに色を**、色合いまで："an off the shoulder grey cutoff sweatshirt, high waisted black leggings with a cross stitch band, white Nike gym shoes"。画像を作るためだけに使われます。
    - 重ね着は外側から、"over" で。柄はその色を書きます（"floral blouse in pale peach and green"）。素材も効きます（denim、silk、knit、leather）。
- **picture**：ステップ 2 で作るか（kind **outfit**：着る人を頭からつま先まで、無地のグレーの上）、自分の画像。name が言わない細部をすべて持ちます。
- **どう使われるか：**
    - 全員、キャストカードの 👗 outfit から始まります。着替えるには、ショットで **👗** から別の衣装を選ぶか、アクションで名前を出します（"Nova comes back in the red dress"）。そのショットからはその衣装のままです。
    - 各ショットのプロンプトに "wearing <name>" と衣装の画像が入ります。クローズアップは寄りのまま：言葉にパンツや靴は入れないでください。
    - テスト済み：片方の肩紐の赤いドレス（銀の飾り付き）が、"red dress" という名前だけで画像から正しく再現されました。
    - ⚠️ **Mismatched reference**：以前のカメラに戻るカットは、そのショットの最初のフレームから始まり、ワイドショットは場所の最初のワイドから部屋を取ります。そのフレームに別の服、人、小道具が映っていると、Story が警告します。開始フレームを固定するか、そのシーンに専用の place カードを付けてください。

### 📍 Places：場所 1 つにつき 1 枚のカード
- **name**："the cafe"。ショットはこの名前で場所を選びます。
- **sound**：部屋の環境音、"soft cafe chatter, cups clinking"。
- **description**：そこにあるもの：部屋、家具、光。
- **room picture**：その場所、**誰もいない状態**。ステップ 2 で作るか、自分の画像。
- **🌐 360**（おすすめ）：部屋全体の**1 枚**のパノラマ（ステップ 2）。ショットごとに画像を作る必要はありません：Story が各ショットの視点をそこから自動で切り出します。
    - **一度だけ設定：** 場所の下にある小さなビューアーを回して、ワイドショットに映るものと同じ向きにします（**📷 the wide shot faces**）。それが「正面」です。すべての角度はそこから数えます：90 = 部屋の右側、-90 = 左側、180 = カメラの後ろ。
    - **クローズアップとミディアムショットは自動で視点が決まります。** すでに角度を持っている人とテーブルを挟んだショットは逆の角度（+180）になるので、2 人の背後には部屋の反対側が映ります。それ以外はワイドショットと同じ向きです。
    - **別の角度にしたい？** ショットカードの **🌐** を押して視点をドラッグしてください。あなたの角度が常に自動の角度より優先されます。
    - 視点は平面の画像として切り出され（プロジェクトの `views/` フォルダ）、Make とストーリーボードの両方でそのショットの背景に使われます。
    - ワイドショットは room picture とアンカーを使います。🌐 で向きを決めた場合は別です。
- **📌 anchors**：カットをまたいでこの部屋を同じに保つフレーム。最初は空です：下の **📌 Anchors** を参照。

### 👜 Props：大事な物 1 つにつき 1 枚のカード
- すべてのショットで同じ見た目でなければならない物だけ（赤い傘、手紙、指輪）。
- **name**："the red umbrella"。✋ ショットのアクションで**この言葉そのまま**を使うと、そのショットに小道具の画像が入ります。
- **description**：どんな見た目か。
- **picture**：ステップ 2 で作るか（kind **prop**）、自分の画像。キャストと同じく無地のグレーの上に置かれます。

### 🎞 Shots：1 ショットにつき 1 枚のカード、上から下がそのまま映画
- **framing**：カメラの近さ。
    - **wide shot**：部屋全体とそこにいる全員。シーンはこれで始めてください。
    - **side view**、**two-shot**：2 人がフレームに入ります。
    - **medium shot**：腰から上。**close-up**：顔と肩。**extreme close-up**：顔。
    - **over the shoulder**、**from behind**、**custom**（アクションで説明します）。
- **who it's on**：カメラが映す人（または全員）。
- **move**：still、slow push-in、slow pull back、pan、tracking、orbit、handheld。still が一番安全です。
- **✂ cut / 🎞 keep rolling**：
    - **cut**：新しいショット。顔、部屋、アンカーをもらいます。ほぼいつもこれを使ってください。
    - **keep rolling**：カットなし、カメラは前のショットの終わりからそのまま続けます。**画像はもらわず**、続きになるフレームだけです。
    - ⚠️ keep rolling は**同じ場所**で**同じ framing** のときだけ使えます。framing を変えるとカットとして作られるか、H3 が勝手に、自分で作った部屋へカットします。
- **where**：場所。空 = 前のショットと同じ場所。
- **seconds**：空（**auto**）ならアクションとセリフに合わせます。数字を入れるとその長さになります。収まらないセリフはショットを延ばします。
- **action**：セリフの前に起きること。短い文、現在形、1 文に 1 つのこと。
- **speaker** + **line**：誰が話すか、そして話すとおりの言葉。1 ショットに 1 行。
- **after**：セリフの後に起きること（任意）。
- **🌐**（任意）：場所の 360 パノラマの中で、このショットのカメラの向きを自分で決めます。クローズアップには自動で角度が付きますが、これが優先されます。**behind** はその人の背後にあるものを言葉で（"the arched windows"）。H3 は画像より言葉に従うので、書いておいてください。
- **🖼 start** / **🏁 end**：ショットの最初または最後のフレーム（ステップ 3、または自分の画像）。H3 は start フレームをそのまま再現します。
- **📐**：誰がどこに立つか（と小道具）をボックスで描きます。ステップ 3 でストーリーボードが使います。
- **🔗 Check the join**（keep rolling のショットのみ）：前のショットが実際にどう終わったかを見て、そこから続くアクションを提案します。
- 各カードの下のプレビューに、H3 に渡る内容そのものと**警告**（🛑 必ず直す、⚠️ 確認したほうがいい）が表示されます。
- **max_shot_seconds**（ノード上、20）：一度に作る最長のショット。それより長いショットは、互いに続く複数のパートに分けて作られます。

## ✍️ プロンプトの書き方：
### 📖 **完全ガイド：** [H3 Showrunner プロンプトガイド](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes/blob/main/assets/H3_Showrunner_Prompting_Guide.md)

### 短く言うと：

- **Looks**：それぞれ 1 行で、頭と髪だけ。髪の長さを書かないと、H3 が勝手に決めます。
- **Outfits**：カードにはシンプルな名前（"gym clothes"）。詳細は description に、すべてのアイテムに色合い付きの色を："faded olive jacket over a cream t-shirt"。
- **クローズアップ**：アクションで相手の名前を出さないでください。"Anika stares at Nova" だと、Anika のクローズアップの途中で H3 が Nova にカットしました。"Anika stares across the table"（Anika はテーブルの向こうを見つめる）なら、ショットの最後まで彼女のままでした。Story が警告します（⚠️）。
- **小道具の数は一度だけ書く**："Each of them holds one cup." そうしないと余分なものが出てきます。
- **小道具はカードと同じ名前で**：カードが "the red umbrella" なら、アクションは "Nova opens the red umbrella."
- **テーブル越しのクローズアップ**："Seen straight on from across the table, nobody in the foreground: the table edge runs along the bottom of the frame, her body square to the camera, eyes just past the lens to the left." そのあと彼女の背後に何があるかを書きます。
- **セリフ中に口を使う動作はなし**：話しながら飲んだり食べたりすると口の動きが崩れます。Story がカップを置かせてくれますが、ひと口飲むのはセリフの後に書いてください。
- **起きないことではなく、起きることを書く**："Nova sits still and listens"、"Nova doesn't move" ではなく。

---

## ステップ 2：📸 画像を作る

- 🔀 **Story Card Prompt** をオン、**Make** をオフ。画像 1 枚につき 1 回 Run します。
- **LC H3 Story Card Prompt** で **kind** を選び、カードの **name** を入力します（空 = その種類の最初のカード）：
    - **cast card**：look から作るヘッドショット：頭と髪、落ち着いた無表情、服なし、無地のグレーの上。
    - **cast card + outfit**：ヘッドショットと 👗 outfit picture（outfit notes から作る、頭からつま先までの人物）を 1 回の Run で。
    - **cast outfit**：👗 outfit picture だけ。
    - **outfit**：衣装カードの description の服を、着る人に着せて頭からつま先まで、無地のグレーの上（誰も着ない場合は見えないマネキン）。
    - **place**：誰もいない部屋、空間全体が見える状態。
    - **360 panorama**：🌐 スロット用の、部屋をぐるりと一周したもの（2:1）。
    - **prop**：物だけ、無地のグレーの上。
- 画像は自動でカードに入ります。新しい画像が古い画像を上書きすることはありません。
- ✋ **キャスト、衣装、小道具の画像は必ず無地のグレーになります**：ここで作っても自分でドロップしても、背景は取り除かれます（BiRefNet）。カード自体の背景、小道具、表情は、それが出るすべてのショットに漏れ出します。
- 💡 気に入らない？もう一度 Run してください：シードは Run のたびに変わります。最後に作ったものがカードに入ります。
- 💡 **無表情だけ。** 笑顔のカードだと、すべてのショットで笑顔の役者になります。完全な固定ではありませんが、引っ張られます。
- 💡 **360 panorama**：場所ごとに 1 枚。何枚か作って、水平線がまっすぐで誰もいないものを残し、場所カードで **📷 the wide shot faces** を一度だけ設定してください。
- 📚 **自分で作らなくても OK：** キャスト、衣装、小道具、🌐 360 の各画像スロットのピッカーに **📚 Library** タブがあります。用意済みの画像が 102 枚（キャストの顔写真 30、季節の衣装 32、小道具 24、360 パノラマ 16）。
    - 1 枚クリックすると、1 回だけダウンロードされてカードに入ります。空のカードには名前とテキストも入ります。
    - 一覧を見る：[Hugging Face の LC H3 Library](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lonecatone23/lc-h3-library)

---

## ステップ 3：🗺️ ストーリーボード（任意、おすすめ）

各ショットの最初のフレームをカードから作るので、どのショットも正しい人が正しい部屋にいる状態から始まります。

- 🔀 **Storyboard** をオン、**Make** をオフ。
- 各ショットカードで **📐** を押し、人物（と小道具）ごとにいてほしい場所へボックスを描きます。各ボックスが誰かを選びます。
- Run します。**MOSS** がボックスからショットをレイアウトし、**Krea 2 Identity Edit** がキャストカードを使ってシャープに描き直します。結果はショットの **🖼 start** スロットに入ります。
- **shot** を空にしておくと、Run のたびに、まだ start フレームがない次のショットを埋めます。1 ショットにつき 1 回 Run。
- すでに見せた場所での後のワイドショットは、最初のワイドショットのフレームから作られるので、部屋、テーブル、カメラの側がそのまま保たれます。
    - ✋ **変わる人だけをボックスで囲んでください**（赤いドレスで戻ってくる Nova）。囲んだ人は全員描き直されるので、顔がずれることがあります。
- ✋ **start フレームはアクションの最初の瞬間です。** フレームですでに座っている Nova + "Nova comes back and sits down" だと、2 人目の Nova が歩いて入ってきました。彼女が来る場所にボックスを置くか、フレームの状態からアクションを書いてください。
- ✋ **H3 は start フレームをそのまま再現します。** ぼやけた画像や間違った画像は、ぼやけた、または間違ったショットになります。スロットの ↻ で空にすると、次の Run でもう一度作られます。

---

## ステップ 4：🎥 映画を作る

- 🔀 **Make** をオン、画像の部分はオフ。**Run** を 1 回押します。
- 1 回の Run で映画全体を、ショットを順番に作り、作りながらつないでいきます。1 ショットでも 20 でも。
- **Stop** でキューに何も残さず終わります。もう一度 Run すると、止まったところから再開します。
- **ボード**（Story ノードのショットの下）：
    - ✅ 作成済み、✏️ 作成後に変更あり、🔒 ロック中。
    - ▶ でショットを再生。↻ で新しいシードで作り直します（古いテイクは `takes/` に残ります）。🔒 で残したいものをロックし、何も作り直さないようにします。
    - 🎬 で映画全体を再生。
- **ショットを変えた？** ✏️ になります。Run は ✏️ のショットだけを作り直し、残りはそのままです。
- **info**（Make のテキスト出力）がショットごとに出ます：
    - **face match**：0.55 以上 = 同じ人、0.40 から 0.55 = 近い、0.40 未満 = 別人。やり直してください。
    - **join**：keep rolling のつなぎがそれぞれどれだけなめらかか。

### 📌 Anchors：部屋を同じに保つ
- **何か：** 場所の静止フレームで、場所カードの **📌 anchors** の行に保存されます。部屋がどうあるべきかを H3 に見せます：家具、窓、誰がどこに座るか。
- **なぜ：** カットのたびに H3 は部屋を作り直します。まねするものがないと、カフェのカウンターが変わり、テーブルが動き、人が席を入れ替わります。
- **自動**（Make の **hold_scene** がオン、デフォルト）：その場所で最初に作ったワイドショットがアンカーになります。その場所で後に続く、**2 人以上**がいるカットはすべてそれをもらいます。1 人のクローズアップは代わりに room picture か 360 の視点をもらいます。
- **自分で選ぶ**（こちらのほうが良い）：ボードで作ったショットを再生し（▶）、部屋と全員が正しく見えるフレームで一時停止して **📌** を押します。その場所の anchors の行に入り、自動のものと置き換わります。行の **+** の四角にはどんな画像でも入れられます。
- すでに見せたセットアップ（同じ場所、framing、人物）に**カットで戻る**と、自動でそのショットの最初のフレームから始まるので、カメラ、部屋、人物が一致します。最初のショットを作り直すと、戻りのカットも ✏️ になります。
- keep rolling のショットはアンカーをもらいません：前のフレームから続くからです。
- ストーリーボードの start フレーム（ステップ 3）はアンカーより優先されます：H3 はそれをそのまま再現します。アンカーが一番効くのは、start フレームのないショットです。
- アンカーの × で削除します。

---

## ステップ 5：🎞️ Post Processing（映画ができたら）

### ⚠️ **Save Video 💾** をオンにしないと保存されません！
- **Make** はオンのままに：すべてのショットができていれば、完成した映画を渡すだけです。何も再レンダリングされません。
- パネルで使いたいものをこの順番でオンにします：
    - **Load Video**：以下のすべてに必要です。
    - **VOSR2 2x**：私のテストで一番ディテールが残りました。25 秒の映画で約 16 分。
    - **Frame Interpolate** 24 → 48：ほんの少しのディテールと引き換えに、ガタつきが約半分に。1 分以内。
    - **RTX Super Resolution**：VOSR2 の後の **deblur** でエッジがシャープになります。
    - **Film Grain**：0.25 で軽いフィルムの質感。

- **이게 하는 일:** 노드 하나에 짧은 영화를 쓰고 (누가 나오는지, 어디서 일어나는지, 모든 샷), 사람과 장소마다 이미지를 만든 다음 **Run**을 누르면 돼요. MiniMax H3로 샷을 하나씩 렌더하고, 소리와 대사가 있는 영화 하나로 이어 붙여요.
- **단계를 순서대로 하세요.** 각 단계는 앞 단계에서 만든 걸 써요. 건너뛰면 낯선 사람이 아무 방에나 나오는 지름길이에요.
- **💡 가이드 투어:** **Vision Assistant** (왼쪽 사이드바) → **Tour**를 여세요. 워크플로우의 각 부분을 순서대로 비추고 중요한 설정을 표시해 줘요. 이 노트와 함께 쓰세요.
- 🛑🚫 **노드를 수동으로 bypass하지 마세요.** 각 부분에 스위치가 있어요 (아래 참고).
- ⚠️ **큰 모델**로 하는 **긴 작업**이에요. 960 x 544에서는 VRAM 32 GB면 여유로워요. 그보다 적어도 되지만 더 느려요.

### 기본
- **이 워크플로우는 모든 단계를 저장해요.**
   - 이미지, 영상 구간 등을 만들었다면 프로젝트를 💾 저장하고, 다른 프로젝트를 작업하다가 언제든 돌아오거나 한 구간을 다시 할 수 있어요.

- **단계 사이 전환:** **Section Bypasser** 패널이 워크플로우의 큰 부분을 통째로 켜고 꺼요. 한 번에 한 부분만 실행돼요:
    - **Story Card Prompt**: 카드용 이미지를 만들어요 (2단계).
    - **Storyboard**: 각 샷의 첫 프레임을 만들어요 (3단계).
    - **Make**: 영화를 렌더해요 (4단계).
    - ⚠️ **이미지를 만드는 동안 Make는 꺼 두세요.** 새 이미지는 그걸 쓰는 샷을 바꾸고, Make가 같은 Run에서 그 샷들을 다시 렌더해요. bypasser가 이걸 자동으로 처리해요.
- **저장💾** 모든 것이 Story 노드에서 이름 붙인 **프로젝트** 폴더에 저장돼요. ComfyUI를 닫고 내일 돌아와도 전부 그대로 있어요.

**🎨후처리 (Post processing)**
- 쓸 준비가 될 때까지 이 스위치들은 꺼 두세요
- 영화 전체를 한 번에 처리하고 무거워서, 그냥 돌아가게 두지는 않을 거예요.

## 1단계: 🎬 이야기 쓰기

모든 것이 큰 **LC H3 Story** 노드에서 일어나요. 목록이 다섯 개 있어요: **🎭 Cast**, **👗 Outfits**, **📍 Places**, **👜 Props**, **🎞 Shots**.

- ✋ **샷이 만드는 텍스트가 H3가 받는 그대로예요.** 뒤에서 몰래 고쳐 쓰는 건 없어요. 샷의 미리보기를 열어 읽어 보세요.
- **project name** (맨 위): 모든 것이 저장되는 폴더, `output/LC_H3/<name>/`. 먼저 이름을 정하세요. **📂**는 저장된 프로젝트를 열고, **💾**는 지금 저장해요 (Run할 때마다 저장도 돼요).
- **영화 전체의 룩** (맨 윗줄): 영상 스타일을 몇 단어로 ("cinematic, soft natural light, shallow depth of field"). 모든 샷에 들어가요.

### ✨ 이야기 쓰기 (선택)
- 짧은 줄거리를 입력하고 ("Nova and Anika meet for coffee, Anika tells a story that goes too far, Nova leaves") **✨ Write the story**를 누르세요. 로컬 모델이 룩, 출연진, 장소, 샷을 한 번 채워 줘요.
- 그 다음부터는 직접 고치는 일반 텍스트예요. 버튼을 다시 누르지 않는 한 다시 쓰지 않아요 (다시 누르면 카드를 교체해요. 같은 이름 카드의 이미지와 목소리는 남아요).
- 위의 **Story writer 모델**이 필요해요. 버튼 옆 드롭다운에서 고르세요.

### 🎭 Cast: 한 사람당 카드 하나
- **Name**: 대문자로 시작하세요. 샷은 정확히 이 이름으로 사람을 찾아요.
- **who**: woman, man, girl, boy, person, cat, dog. 프롬프트에서 사람들을 구별해 줘요.
- **look**: 한 줄, H3가 가장 잘 따르는 단어들. 머리와 헤어까지만 쓰고 멈추세요: 나이, 얼굴, 눈, 주근깨, 피부, 머리 (길이도). "mid twenties, a soft oval face, green eyes, light freckles, long wavy blonde hair". 옷은 절대 넣지 마세요: 옷은 outfit 사진에 들어가요.
- **face picture**: 2단계에서 만든 얼굴 사진, 또는 직접 가진 사진 (사각형을 클릭하거나 이미지를 끌어다 놓으세요). 배경은 자동으로 지워지고 얼굴은 단색 회색 배경 위에 놓여서, 장면이나 옷으로 번지지 않아요.
    - 얼굴 사진은 머리와 헤어까지예요. 어깨도 옷도 안 돼요: 얼굴 사진에 옷이 있으면 모든 outfit 사진을 이겨요.
- **👗 outfit picture**: 첫 샷부터 입고 있는 옷, 머리부터 발끝까지. 2단계에서 만들거나 (kind **cast card + outfit**은 얼굴 사진과 함께 한 번의 Run으로 만들어요), 직접 가진 것.
    - **outfit notes**: 의상 전체를 자세히. 이것으로 사진만 만들고, H3는 절대 읽지 않아요.
- **🎤 voice** (선택): 그 사람 목소리의 2~15초 클립. H3는 말 내용이 아니라 목소리를 따라 해요.
- **📋**는 이름과 look을 복사해서 다른 워크플로우에 붙여 넣을 수 있게 해요.

### 👗 Outfits: 옷, 의상 하나당 카드 하나
- ✋ **모두 어딘가에서 옷을 받아야 해요.** 얼굴 사진에는 옷이 없어요. 사람마다 cast 카드에 👗 outfit 사진을 주세요. 없으면 샷마다 옷이 달라지고, Story가 경고해요 (👗).
- outfit 카드는 갈아입는 옷이에요.
- **name**: 단순한 이름으로: "red cocktail dress", "yoga outfit", "gym clothes". 사진이 있으면 H3가 그 의상에 대해 읽는 건 이것뿐이에요.
    - 조각들을 나열하지 마세요. 단어에 신발과 바지가 들어가면 close-up이 wide로 끌려가요 (Story가 경고해요).
- **who wears it**: 입는 사람.
- **description**: 머리부터 발끝까지 의상 전체를 자세히, **모든 아이템에 색을**, 색조까지: "an off the shoulder grey cutoff sweatshirt, high waisted black leggings with a cross stitch band, white Nike gym shoes". 이것으로 사진만 만들어요.
    - 겉옷부터, "over"로 겹쳐서. 무늬는 색을 말하세요 ("floral blouse in pale peach and green"). 소재도 도움이 돼요 (denim, silk, knit, leather).
- **picture**: 2단계에서 만들거나 (kind **outfit**: 입는 사람, 머리부터 발끝까지, 단색 회색 위), 직접 가진 것. name이 말하지 않는 모든 디테일을 담아요.
- **어떻게 작동하나:**
    - 모두 cast 카드의 👗 outfit으로 시작해요. 바꾸려면 **👗**가 있는 샷에서 다른 것을 고르거나, action에 이름을 쓰세요 ("Nova comes back in the red dress"). 그 샷부터 계속 그 옷을 입어요.
    - 각 샷의 프롬프트에 "wearing <name>"과 outfit 사진이 들어가요. Close-up은 close-up으로 유지돼요: 단어에 바지나 신발을 넣지 마세요.
    - 테스트: 어깨끈 하나에 은색 디테일이 있는 빨간 드레스가 "red dress"라고만 불렀는데도 사진만으로 그대로 나왔어요.
    - ⚠️ **Mismatched reference**: 이전 카메라로 돌아가는 컷은 그 샷의 첫 프레임에서 시작하고, wide는 장소의 첫 wide에서 공간을 가져와요. 그 프레임에 다른 옷, 사람, 소품이 보이면 Story가 경고해요. 시작 프레임을 고정하거나, 그 장면에 전용 place 카드를 주세요.

### 📍 Places: 장소 하나당 카드 하나
- **name**: "the cafe". 샷은 이 이름으로 장소를 골라요.
- **sound**: 공간의 배경음, "soft cafe chatter, cups clinking".
- **description**: 거기 있는 것: 공간, 가구, 조명.
- **room picture**: **비어 있는** 장소. 2단계에서 만들거나 직접 가진 것.
- **🌐 360** (추천): 공간 전체의 파노라마 **하나** (2단계). 샷마다 이미지를 만들 필요 없어요: Story가 각 샷의 시야를 거기서 알아서 잘라내요.
    - **한 번만 설정:** 장소 아래 작은 뷰어를 돌려서 wide shot이 보여 주는 장면이 나오게 하세요 (**📷 the wide shot faces**). 그게 "정면"이에요. 모든 각도는 거기서부터 세요: 90 = 공간의 오른쪽, -90 = 왼쪽, 180 = 카메라 뒤.
    - **close-up과 medium shot은 시야가 자동으로 정해져요.** 이미 각도가 있는 사람의 테이블 건너편 샷은 역각도 (+180)를 받아서, 두 사람 뒤에 공간의 반대쪽이 보여요. 나머지는 wide shot과 같은 방향을 봐요.
    - **다른 각도를 원하면?** 샷 카드의 **🌐**를 누르고 시야를 드래그하세요. 직접 정한 각도가 항상 자동보다 우선해요.
    - 시야는 평면 이미지로 잘라내져서 (프로젝트의 `views/` 폴더), Make와 스토리보드가 그 샷의 배경으로 써요.
    - wide shot은 room picture와 anchor를 써요. 🌐로 직접 맞추지 않는 한요.
- **📌 anchors**: 컷이 바뀌어도 이 공간을 똑같이 유지하는 프레임. 처음엔 비어 있어요: 아래 **📌 Anchors**를 보세요.

### 👜 Props: 중요한 물건 하나당 카드 하나
- 모든 샷에서 똑같아 보여야 하는 물건에만 (빨간 우산, 편지, 반지).
- **name**: "the red umbrella". ✋ 샷의 action에서 **정확히 이 단어**를 쓰면, 그 샷이 소품 이미지를 받아요.
- **description**: 어떻게 생겼는지.
- **picture**: 2단계에서 만들거나 (kind **prop**), 직접 가진 것. cast처럼 단색 회색 위에 놓여요.

### 🎞 Shots: 샷 하나당 카드 하나, 위에서 아래로가 영화예요
- **framing**: 카메라가 얼마나 가까운지.
    - **wide shot**: 공간 전체와 거기 있는 모두. 장면을 이걸로 시작하세요.
    - **side view**, **two-shot**: 두 사람이 화면에.
    - **medium shot**: 허리 위. **close-up**: 얼굴과 어깨. **extreme close-up**: 얼굴.
    - **over the shoulder**, **from behind**, **custom** (action에서 직접 설명).
- **who it's on**: 카메라가 비추는 사람 (또는 모두).
- **move**: still, slow push-in, slow pull back, pan, tracking, orbit, handheld. still이 가장 안전해요.
- **✂ cut / 🎞 keep rolling**:
    - **cut**: 새 샷. 얼굴, 공간, anchor를 받아요. 거의 항상 이걸 쓰세요.
    - **keep rolling**: 컷 없이, 카메라가 앞 샷의 끝에서 그대로 이어가요. **이미지를 받지 않고**, 이어받는 프레임만 받아요.
    - ⚠️ keep rolling은 **같은 장소**에서 **같은 framing**일 때만 돼요. framing을 바꾸면 cut으로 만들어지거나, H3가 알아서 지어낸 공간으로 컷해 버려요.
- **where**: 장소. 비우면 = 앞 샷과 같은 장소.
- **seconds**: 비우면 (**auto**) action과 대사에 맞춰요. 숫자를 넣으면 그 길이로. 들어가지 않는 대사는 샷을 늘려요.
- **action**: 대사 전에 일어나는 일. 짧은 문장, 현재형, 한 문장에 한 가지.
- **speaker** + **line**: 누가 말하는지, 그리고 말하는 그대로의 대사. 샷 하나에 대사 하나.
- **after**: 대사 후에 일어나는 일 (선택).
- **🌐** (선택): 장소의 360 파노라마 안에서 이 샷의 카메라를 직접 맞춰요. close-up은 각도가 자동으로 정해지고, 이건 그걸 덮어써요. **behind**는 그 사람 뒤에 있는 것을 말로 ("the arched windows"). H3는 이미지보다 말을 따르니까 꼭 채우세요.
- **🖼 start** / **🏁 end**: 샷의 첫 프레임 또는 마지막 프레임 (3단계, 또는 직접 가진 것). H3는 start 프레임을 그대로 따라 해요.
- **📐**: 누가 어디 서는지 (그리고 소품) 박스를 그려요. 스토리보드가 3단계에서 써요.
- **🔗 Check the join** (keep rolling 샷만): 앞 샷이 실제로 어떻게 끝났는지 보고, 거기서 이어지는 action을 제안해요.
- 각 카드 아래 미리보기는 H3가 받는 그대로와 **경고**를 보여 줘요 (🛑 꼭 고치기, ⚠️ 확인해 보기).
- **max_shot_seconds** (노드에서, 20): 한 번에 만드는 가장 긴 샷. 더 긴 샷은 서로 이어지는 여러 부분으로 만들어요.

## ✍️ 프롬프트 작성:
### 📖 **전체 가이드:** [H3 Showrunner 프롬프트 가이드](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes/blob/main/assets/H3_Showrunner_Prompting_Guide.md)

### 짧은 버전:

- **Looks**: 한 사람당 한 줄, 머리와 헤어만. 머리 길이를 말하세요, 안 그러면 H3가 아무거나 골라요.
- **Outfits**: 카드에는 단순한 이름 ("gym clothes"). 디테일은 description에, 모든 아이템에 색조까지 있는 색: "faded olive jacket over a cream t-shirt".
- **Close-ups**: action에 상대방 이름을 쓰지 마세요. "Anika stares at Nova"는 Anika의 close-up 중간에 H3가 Nova로 컷해 버렸어요. "Anika stares across the table" (Anika가 테이블 건너편을 응시한다)는 샷 내내 Anika를 유지했어요. Story가 경고해 줘요 (⚠️).
- **소품은 한 번 세기**: "Each of them holds one cup." 안 그러면 여분이 나타나요.
- **소품 이름은 카드와 똑같이**: 카드가 "the red umbrella"면, action은 "Nova opens the red umbrella."
- **테이블 건너편 close-up**: "Seen straight on from across the table, nobody in the foreground: the table edge runs along the bottom of the frame, her body square to the camera, eyes just past the lens to the left." 그 다음 그녀 뒤에 뭐가 있는지 말하세요.
- **대사 중엔 입 동작 금지**: 말하면서 마시거나 먹으면 입술이 사라져요. Story가 컵을 내려놓게 해 주지만, 마시는 건 대사 뒤에 쓰세요.
- **일어나지 않는 것 말고 일어나는 것을 말하기**: "Nova doesn't move"가 아니라 "Nova sits still and listens".

---

## 2단계: 📸 이미지 만들기

- 🔀 **Story Card Prompt** 켜고, **Make** 끄기. 이미지 하나당 한 번 Run.
- **LC H3 Story Card Prompt**에서 **kind**를 고르고 카드의 **name**을 입력하세요 (비우면 = 그 종류의 첫 카드):
    - **cast card**: look으로 만든 얼굴 사진: 머리와 헤어, 차분한 무표정, 옷 없이, 단색 회색 위.
    - **cast card + outfit**: 얼굴 사진과 👗 outfit 사진 (outfit notes로 만든, 머리부터 발끝까지의 사람)을 한 번의 Run으로.
    - **cast outfit**: 👗 outfit 사진만.
    - **outfit**: outfit 카드의 description을 입는 사람에게, 머리부터 발끝까지, 단색 회색 위 (입는 사람이 없으면 투명 마네킹).
    - **place**: 비어 있는 공간, 전체가 보이게.
    - **360 panorama**: 공간을 한 바퀴 전부 (2:1), 🌐 슬롯용.
    - **prop**: 물건만 단독으로, 단색 회색 위.
- 이미지는 알아서 카드에 들어가요. 새 이미지가 이전 이미지를 덮어쓰는 일은 없어요.
- ✋ **cast, outfit, prop 이미지는 항상 단색 회색 위로 가요**: 여기서 만들든 직접 끌어다 놓든 배경이 지워져요 (BiRefNet). 카드 자체의 배경, 소품, 표정은 그 카드가 나오는 모든 샷으로 새어 나가요.
- 💡 마음에 안 들면? 다시 Run하세요: Run할 때마다 시드가 바뀌어요. 마지막에 만든 게 카드에 들어가요.
- 💡 **무표정 얼굴만.** 웃는 카드는 모든 샷에서 웃는 배우를 줘요. 완전히 고정되는 건 아니지만 끌려가요.
- 💡 **360 panorama**: 장소당 하나. 몇 개 만들어서 수평선이 평평하고 아무도 없는 걸 하나 고르고, place 카드에서 **📷 the wide shot faces**를 한 번 설정하세요.
- 📚 **직접 만들지 않아도 돼요:** 캐스트, 의상, 소품, 🌐 360 이미지 슬롯의 이미지 선택창에 **📚 Library** 탭이 있어요. 미리 만든 이미지 102장(캐스트 얼굴 사진 30, 계절 의상 32, 소품 24, 360 파노라마 16).
    - 하나를 클릭하면 한 번만 다운로드되어 카드에 들어가요. 빈 카드에는 이름과 텍스트도 채워져요.
    - 전체 보기: [Hugging Face의 LC H3 Library](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lonecatone23/lc-h3-library)

---

## 3단계: 🗺️ Storyboard (선택, 추천)

카드로 만든 각 샷의 첫 프레임이에요. 그래서 모든 샷이 맞는 공간에 맞는 사람들로 시작해요.

- 🔀 **Storyboard** 켜고, **Make** 끄기.
- 각 샷 카드에서 **📐**를 누르고 사람마다 (그리고 소품마다) 있어야 할 자리에 박스를 그리세요. 박스마다 누구인지 고르세요.
- Run. **MOSS**가 박스대로 샷을 배치하고, **Krea 2 Identity Edit**가 cast 카드로 선명하게 다시 그려요. 샷의 **🖼 start** 슬롯에 들어가요.
- **shot**을 비워 두면 Run할 때마다 start 프레임이 아직 없는 다음 샷을 채워요. 샷 하나당 한 번 Run.
- 이미 보여 준 장소의 나중 wide shot은 첫 wide shot의 프레임으로 만들어져서, 공간, 테이블, 카메라 방향이 그대로 유지돼요.
    - ✋ **바뀌는 사람만 박스로** (빨간 드레스를 입고 돌아오는 Nova). 박스를 친 사람은 모두 다시 그려지고, 얼굴이 달라질 수 있어요.
- ✋ **start 프레임은 action의 첫 순간이에요.** 프레임에 Nova가 이미 앉아 있는데 + "Nova comes back and sits down"을 쓰면 두 번째 Nova가 걸어 들어왔어요. 그녀가 오는 곳에 박스를 치거나, 프레임 상태에서부터 action을 쓰세요.
- ✋ **H3는 start 프레임을 그대로 따라 해요.** 흐리거나 틀린 이미지는 흐리거나 틀린 샷을 만들어요. 슬롯의 ↻는 비우고, 다음 Run에서 다시 만들어요.

---

## 4단계: 🎥 영화 만들기

- 🔀 **Make** 켜고, 이미지 부분은 끄기. **Run**을 한 번 누르세요.
- Run 한 번이면 영화 전체를 샷 하나씩 만들고, 만드는 대로 이어 붙여요. 1샷이든 20샷이든.
- **Stop**을 누르면 큐에 아무것도 남기지 않고 끝나요. 다시 Run하면 멈춘 곳부터 이어가요.
- **보드** (Story 노드의 샷 아래):
    - ✅ 완성, ✏️ 만든 뒤 바뀜, 🔒 잠김.
    - ▶는 샷을 재생해요. ↻는 새 시드로 다시 만들어요 (이전 테이크는 `takes/`에 남아요). 🔒는 마음에 드는 걸 잠가서 아무것도 다시 만들지 않게 해요.
    - 🎬는 영화 전체를 재생해요.
- **샷을 바꿨나요?** ✏️로 바뀌어요. Run하면 ✏️ 샷만 다시 만들고, 나머지는 그대로예요.
- **info** (Make의 텍스트 출력), 샷마다:
    - **face match**: 0.55 이상 = 같은 사람, 0.40~0.55 = 비슷함, 0.40 미만 = 다른 사람. 다시 하세요.
    - **join**: 각 keep rolling 이음새가 얼마나 매끄러운지.

### 📌 Anchors: 공간을 똑같이 유지하기
- **이게 뭔가요:** 장소의 정지 프레임으로, place 카드의 **📌 anchors** 줄에 저장돼요. H3에게 공간이 유지돼야 하는 모습을 보여 줘요: 가구, 창문, 누가 어디 앉는지.
- **왜:** 컷마다 H3는 공간을 다시 만들어요. 따라 할 게 없으면 카페 카운터가 새로 생기고, 테이블이 움직이고, 사람들이 자리를 바꿔요.
- **자동** (Make의 **hold_scene** 켜짐, 기본값): 한 장소에서 처음 만든 wide shot이 그 장소의 anchor가 돼요. 이후 그곳에서 **두 명 이상**이 나오는 컷은 모두 그걸 받아요. 한 사람의 close-up은 대신 room picture나 그 360 시야를 받아요.
- **직접 고르기** (더 좋아요): 보드에서 만든 샷을 재생하고 (▶), 공간과 모두가 제대로 보이는 프레임에서 멈춘 다음 **📌**를 누르세요. 그 장소의 anchors 줄에 들어가서 자동 anchor를 대체해요. 줄의 **+** 사각형은 어떤 이미지든 받아요.
- 이미 보여 준 구도로 **다시 컷하면** (같은 장소, framing, 사람) 그 샷의 첫 프레임에서 알아서 시작해서, 카메라, 공간, 사람이 맞아요. 첫 샷을 다시 만들면 다시 컷한 샷도 ✏️로 표시돼요.
- keep rolling 샷은 anchor를 받지 않아요: 앞의 프레임에서 이어가요.
- 스토리보드 start 프레임 (3단계)이 anchor보다 우선해요: H3가 그대로 따라 하니까요. anchor는 start 프레임이 없는 샷에서 가장 중요해요.
- anchor의 ×는 그걸 지워요.

---

## 5단계: 🎞️ 후처리 (영화가 다 되면)

### ⚠️ **Save Video 💾**를 켜지 않으면 저장되지 않아요!
- **Make**는 켜 두세요: 모든 샷이 만들어져 있으면 완성된 영화를 넘겨주기만 해요. 아무것도 다시 렌더하지 않아요.
- 패널에서 원하는 걸 이 순서대로 켜세요:
    - **Load Video**: 아래 모든 것에 필요해요.
    - **VOSR2 2x**: 제 테스트에서 디테일이 가장 많았고, 25초 영화에 약 16분.
    - **Frame Interpolate** 24 → 48: 디테일을 아주 조금 잃고 떨림이 절반 정도로 줄어요. 1분 이내.
    - **RTX Super Resolution**: VOSR2 뒤의 **deblur**가 가장자리를 선명하게 해요.
    - **Film Grain**: 0.25는 은은한 필름 질감이에요.

- 💡 **Vision Assistant → Models** downloads it with one click.

**Downloads by themselves the first time** (a yellow message tells you, **Stop** cancels)
- **BiRefNet** (takes the background off cast and prop pictures), **VOSR2**, **RIFE 4.26**.
- **RTX Super Resolution** needs an NVIDIA RTX card.

---

## ✋ Read this first

- **What this does:** you write a short movie on one node (who is in it, where it happens, and every shot), make a picture for each person and place, and press **Run**. It renders the shots one after another with MiniMax H3 and joins them into one movie with sound and dialogue.
- **Do the steps in order.** Every step uses what the step before it made. Skipping ahead is the fastest way to get strangers in random rooms.
- **💡 The guided tour:** open **Vision Assistant** (the left sidebar) → **Tour**. It lights up each part of the workflow in order and marks the settings that matter. Use it alongside this note.
- 🛑🚫 **Don't bypass nodes by hand.** Each part has a switch (below).
- ⚠️ This is a **long job** on a **big model**. 32 GB of VRAM is comfortable at 960 x 544. Less works, just slower.

### The basics
- **This workflow saves every step.** 
   - If you create images, video sections, etc., you can 💾 save the project, work on a different project, and come back to it or redo a section at any time.
   -  **Nothing is lost:** what finished stays finished.
- **Switching from step to step:** the **Section Bypasser** panel turns whole parts of the workflow on and off. Only one part runs at a time:
    - **Story Card Prompt**: makes the pictures for your cards (step 2).
    - **Storyboard**: makes the first frame of each shot (step 3).
    - **Make**: renders the movie (step 4).
    - ⚠️ **Make must be off while you make pictures.** A new picture changes the shots that use it, and Make would render them again on the same Run. The bypasser does that automatically.
- **Save💾** Everything is saved in a **project** folder named on the Story node. Close ComfyUI, come back tomorrow, and it's all still there.

**🎨Post processing**
- Leave these switches off until you are ready to use it
- It processes the entire movie all at once and it is heavy, so I would not let it just run.
- **Make** switch needs to be on.

---

## ⚙️ Settings (set once, before step 1)

- **megapixels**: 0.52 = 960 x 544 is the tested size.
   - Keep one size for the whole project; changing it later means making every shot again.
   - 💡 Don't stress too much over quality here. Push out decent, but 1 MP just slows down what you can upscale in the end.
- **Steps**: 8 with the turbo LoRA (Models & LoRAs). More steps without turbo is slower and not better in my tests.
- **LC Seed**: the seed generator is the starting seed for H3 (each new shot) and the storyboard (MOSS and Krea 2: seed + shot number).
   - Every made shot keeps its own seed with its take, and ↻ (remake) always picks a new one.
   - The card pictures and post processing have their own seeds. Leave it alone.
- **Models & LoRAs**: the LC Optimizer picks the H3 files for your card. 
   - I suggest leaving it on **★ Recommended**.
   - I've tested it on other models. 10EROS works well, Singularity has voice issues. 
   - LoRAs. Your mileage will vary. 


---

## Step 1: 🎬 Write the story

Everything happens on the big **LC H3 Story** node. It has five lists: **🎭 Cast**, **👗 Outfits**, **📍 Places**, **👜 Props** and **🎞 Shots**.

- ✋ **The text a shot builds is exactly what H3 gets.** Nothing rewrites it behind your back. Open a shot's preview to read it.
- **project name** (top): the folder everything is saved in, `output/LC_H3/<name>/`. Name it first. **📂** opens a saved project, **💾** saves now (every Run saves too).
- **The look of the whole movie** (top line): a few words for the film style ("cinematic, soft natural light, shallow depth of field"). It goes into every shot.

### ✨ Write the story (optional)
- Type a short pitch ("Nova and Anika meet for coffee, Anika tells a story that goes too far, Nova leaves") and press **✨ Write the story**. A local model fills in the look, cast, places and shots once.
- After that it's plain text you edit. It never writes again unless you press the button again (which replaces the cards; pictures and voices on cards with the same name stay).
- Needs the **Story writer model** above. Pick it in the dropdown next to the button.


### 🎭 Cast: one card per person
- **Name**: start with a capital letter. Shots find people by this exact name.
- **who**: woman, man, girl, boy, person, cat, dog. It tells people apart in the prompt.
- **look**: one line, the words H3 follows most. Describe the head and hair, then stop: age, face, eyes, freckles, skin, hair (length too). "mid twenties, a soft oval face, green eyes, light freckles, long wavy blonde hair". Never clothes: they go in the outfit picture.
- **face picture**: a headshot, made in step 2, or yours (click the square or drop a picture on it). The background is automatically removed and the face is placed on a plain grey background to prevent it from bleeding into the scene or outfit.
    - Headshot means head and hair. No shoulders, no clothes: clothes in a headshot beat every outfit picture.
- **👗 outfit picture**: what they wear from their first shot, head to toe. Made in step 2 (kind **cast card + outfit** makes it and the headshot in one Run), or yours.
    - **outfit notes**: the whole outfit in detail. Only the picture is made from it, H3 never reads it.
- **🎤 voice** (optional): a 2 to 15 s clip of how they sound. H3 copies the voice, not the words.
- **📋** copies the name and look to paste into another workflow.

### 👗 Outfits: the clothes, one card per outfit
- ✋ **Everyone needs clothes from somewhere.** The headshot carries none. Give each person a 👗 outfit picture on their cast card. With none, they get different clothes in every shot, and the Story warns you (👗).
- An outfit card is a change of clothes.
- **name**: a simple name: "red cocktail dress", "yoga outfit", "gym clothes". With a picture, it's all H3 reads about the outfit.
    - Never a list of pieces. Shoes and pants in the words pull close-ups wide (the Story warns you).
- **who wears it**: the person.
- **description**: the whole outfit head to toe, in detail, **a color for every item**, with the shade: "an off the shoulder grey cutoff sweatshirt, high waisted black leggings with a cross stitch band, white Nike gym shoes". Only the picture is made from it.
    - Layers outside first, with "over". Patterns name their colors ("floral blouse in pale peach and green"). Fabric helps (denim, silk, knit, leather).
- **picture**: made in step 2 (kind **outfit**: the person who wears it, head to toe, on plain grey), or yours. It carries every detail the name doesn't say.
- **How it plays:**
    - Everyone starts in their cast card's 👗 outfit. To change, pick another on a shot with **👗**, or name it in the action ("Nova comes back in the red dress"). They stay in it from that shot on.
    - Each shot gets "wearing <name>" in the prompt and the outfit picture. Close-ups stay close: no pants or shoes in the words.
    - Tested: a one-strap red dress with silver details came through from the picture alone, named just "red dress".
    - ⚠️ **Mismatched reference**: a cut back to an earlier camera opens on that shot's first frame, and a wide takes its room from the place's first wide. If that frame shows other clothes, people or props, the Story warns you. Pin a start frame, or give the scene its own place card.

### 📍 Places: one card per location
- **name**: "the cafe". Shots pick their place by this name.
- **sound**: the room tone, "soft cafe chatter, cups clinking".
- **description**: what is there: the room, the furniture, the light.
- **room picture**: the place, **empty**. Made in step 2, or yours.
- **🌐 360** (recommended): **one** panorama of the whole room (step 2). You don't make a picture per shot: the Story cuts each shot's view out of it by itself.
    - **Set it once:** turn the small viewer under the place until it shows what your wide shot shows (**📷 the wide shot faces**). That is "front". Every angle counts from there: 90 = right side of the room, -90 = left, 180 = behind the camera.
    - **Close-ups and medium shots get their view automatically.** One across the table from someone who already has an angle gets the reverse angle (+180), so the two of them have opposite sides of the room behind them. The others face the way the wide shot faces.
    - **Want a different angle?** Press **🌐** on the shot card and drag the view. Your angle always wins over the automatic one.
    - The view is cut as a flat picture (in the project's `views/` folder) and used as that shot's background, by Make and by the storyboard.
    - Wide shots use the room picture and the anchor, unless you aim them with 🌐 too.
- **📌 anchors**: frames that keep this room the same across cuts. Empty at first: see **📌 Anchors** below.

### 👜 Props: one card per object that matters
- Only for an object that must look the same in every shot (the red umbrella, the letter, the ring).
- **name**: "the red umbrella". ✋ Use these **exact words** in a shot's action, and that shot gets the prop's picture.
- **description**: what it looks like.
- **picture**: made in step 2 (kind **prop**), or yours. It goes on plain grey like the cast.


**💡 Need something simple?** 
- Every cast, outfit, prop and 🌐 360 slot has a 📚 Library tab in its picture picker: 102 ready-made pictures (30 cast headshots, 32 seasonal outfits, 24 props, 16 360 panoramas). Browse them all: [LC H3 Library on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lonecatone23/lc-h3-library)


### 🎞 Shots: one card per shot, top to bottom is the movie
- **framing**: how close the camera is.
    - **wide shot**: the whole room and everyone in it. Start a scene with one.
    - **side view**, **two-shot**: two people in frame.
    - **medium shot**: waist up. **close-up**: face and shoulders. **extreme close-up**: the face.
    - **over the shoulder**, **from behind**, **custom** (you describe it in the action).
- **who it's on**: the person the camera is on (or everyone).
- **move**: still, slow push-in, slow pull back, pan, tracking, orbit, handheld. Still is the safest.
- **✂ cut / 🎞 keep rolling**:
    - **cut**: a new shot. It gets the faces, the room and the anchor. Use it almost always.
    - **keep rolling**: no cut, the camera carries straight on from the end of the shot before. It gets **no pictures**, only the frames it carries on from.
    - ⚠️ Keep rolling only works with the **same framing** in the **same place**. Change the framing and it's made as a cut, or H3 cuts by itself to a room it invents.
- **where**: the place. Empty = the same place as the shot before.
- **seconds**: empty (**auto**) fits the action and the line. Type a number to set it. A line that can't fit stretches the shot.
- **action**: what happens before the line. Short sentences, present tense, one thing each.
- **speaker** + **line**: who talks, and the words exactly as they say them. One line per shot.
- **after**: what happens after the line (optional).
- **🌐** (optional): aim this shot's camera inside the place's 360 panorama yourself. Close-ups get an angle automatically; this overrides it. **behind** is what is behind the person in words ("the arched windows"). H3 follows words over pictures, so fill it in.
- **🖼 start** / **🏁 end**: the first or last frame of the shot (step 3, or yours). H3 copies a start frame exactly.
- **📐**: draw boxes for who stands where (and props). The storyboard uses them in step 3.
- **🔗 Check the join** (keep-rolling shots only): looks at how the shot before really ended and suggests an action that carries on from there.
- The preview under each card shows exactly what H3 gets, and the **warnings** (🛑 must fix, ⚠️ should look at).
- **max_shot_seconds** (on the node, 20): the longest shot made in one go. Longer shots are made in parts that carry on from each other.

---

## ✍️ Prompting:
### 📖 **The full guide:** [H3 Showrunner Prompting Guide](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes/blob/main/assets/H3_Showrunner_Prompting_Guide.md)

### The short version:

- **Looks**: one line each, head and hair only. Say the hair length, or H3 picks one.
- **Outfits**: a simple name on the card ("gym clothes"). The details go in its description, a color with a shade for every item: "faded olive jacket over a cream t-shirt".
- **Close-ups**: don't name the other person in the action. "Anika stares at Nova" made H3 cut to Nova halfway through Anika's close-up. "Anika stares across the table" kept her the whole shot. The Story warns you (⚠️).
- **Count props once**: "Each of them holds one cup." Or extras show up.
- **Name the prop like its card**: the card says "the red umbrella", the action says "Nova opens the red umbrella."
- **Close-ups across a table**: "Seen straight on from across the table, nobody in the foreground: the table edge runs along the bottom of the frame, her body square to the camera, eyes just past the lens to the left." Then say what is behind her.
- **No mouth actions during a line**: drinking or eating while talking loses the lips. The Story puts the cups down for you, but write the sip after the line.
- **Say what happens, not what doesn't**: "Nova sits still and listens", not "Nova doesn't move".

---

## Step 2: 📸 Make the pictures

- 🔀 **Story Card Prompt** on, **Make** off. Run once per picture.
- On **LC H3 Story Card Prompt**, pick the **kind** and type the card's **name** (blank = the first card of that kind):
    - **cast card**: a headshot from the look: head and hair, calm neutral face, no clothes, on plain grey.
    - **cast card + outfit**: the headshot and the 👗 outfit picture (the person head to toe, from the outfit notes) in one Run.
    - **cast outfit**: just the 👗 outfit picture.
    - **outfit**: an outfit card's description on the person who wears it, head to toe, on plain grey (an invisible mannequin when nobody wears it).
    - **place**: the room, empty, the whole space in view.
    - **360 panorama**: the room all the way round (2:1) for the 🌐 slot.
    - **prop**: the object alone, on plain grey.
- The picture lands on its card by itself. A new picture never writes over an old one.
- ✋ **Cast, outfit and prop pictures always end up on plain grey**: drafted here or dropped in yourself, the background comes off (BiRefNet). A card's own background, props and expression leak into every shot it's in.
- 💡 Not happy? Run again: the seed changes every Run. The last one made is the one on the card.
- 💡 **Neutral faces only.** A smiling card gives you a smiling actor in every shot. It's not a hard lock, but it pulls.
- 💡 **360 panorama**: one per place. Make a few and keep one with a level horizon and nobody in it, then set **📷 the wide shot faces** on the place card once.
- 📚 **Or skip making them:** every cast, outfit, prop and 🌐 360 slot has a **📚 Library** tab in its picture picker: 102 ready-made pictures (30 cast headshots, 32 seasonal outfits, 24 props, 16 360 panoramas).
    - Click one: it downloads once and lands on the card. An empty card gets its name and text too.
    - Browse them all: [LC H3 Library on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lonecatone23/lc-h3-library)

---

## Step 3: 🗺️ Storyboard (optional, recommended)

The first frame of each shot, built from your cards, so every shot starts with the right people in the right room.

- 🔀 **Storyboard** on, **Make** off.
- On each shot card, press **📐** and draw a box for each person (and prop) where they should be. Pick who each box is.
- Run. **MOSS** lays the shot out from the boxes, then **Krea 2 Identity Edit** redraws it sharp with your cast cards. It lands in the shot's **🖼 start** slot.
- Leave **shot** blank and every Run fills the next shot still missing its start frame. One Run per shot.
- A later wide shot in a place you've already shown is built from the first wide shot's frame, so the room, the table and the camera side stay put.
    - ✋ **Box only who changes** (Nova coming back in the red dress). Everyone boxed is drawn again, and their face can drift.
- ✋ **The start frame is the action's first moment.** Nova already seated in the frame + "Nova comes back and sits down" gave a second Nova walking in. Box her where she comes from, or write the action from where the frame is.
- ✋ **H3 copies a start frame exactly.** A soft or wrong picture makes a soft or wrong shot. ↻ on the slot empties it and the next Run makes it again.

---

## Step 4: 🎥 Make the movie

- 🔀 **Make** on, the picture parts off. Press **Run** once.
- One Run makes the whole movie, shot after shot, and joins it as it goes. 1 shot or 20.
- **Stop** ends it with nothing left in the queue. Run again and it picks up where it stopped.
- **The board** (under the shots on the Story node):
    - ✅ made, ✏️ changed since it was made, 🔒 locked.
    - ▶ plays a shot. ↻ makes it again with a new seed (the old take is kept in `takes/`). 🔒 locks a keeper so nothing remakes it.
    - 🎬 plays the whole movie.
- **Changed a shot?** It turns ✏️. Run remakes only the ✏️ shots, the rest stay.
- **info** (Make's text output) after every shot:
    - **face match**: 0.55 and up = same person, 0.40 to 0.55 = close, under 0.40 = someone else. Redo it.
    - **join**: how smooth each keep-rolling join is.

### 📌 Anchors: keeping the room the same
- **What it is:** a still frame of a place, saved on the place card's **📌 anchors** row. It shows H3 the room as it must stay: the furniture, the windows, who sits where.
- **Why:** on every cut H3 builds the room again. Without something to copy, the café gets a new counter, the table moves, and people swap seats.
- **Automatic** (Make's **hold_scene** on, the default): the first wide shot made in a place becomes its anchor. Every later cut there with **two or more people** gets it. A close-up of one person gets the room picture or its 360 view instead.
- **Your own** (better): play a made shot on the board (▶), pause on a frame where the room and everyone in it look right, press **📌**. It lands in that place's anchors row and replaces the automatic one. The **+** square in the row takes any picture.
- **Cutting back** to a setup you've already shown (same place, framing and person) opens on that shot's first frame by itself, so the camera, room and people match. Remake the first one and the cut-back is marked ✏️ too.
- Keep-rolling shots never get an anchor: they carry on from the frames before them.
- A storyboard start frame (step 3) beats an anchor: H3 copies it exactly. Anchors matter most for shots without one.
- × on an anchor removes it.

---

## Step 5: 🎞️ Post Processing (when the movie is done)

### ⚠️ It will not save unless **Save Video 💾** is switched on!
- Keep **Make** on: with every shot made it just hands over the finished movie. Nothing renders again.
- Turn on what you want in the panel, in this order:
    - **Load Video**: needed for everything below.
    - **VOSR2 2x**: the most detail in my tests, about 16 minutes for a 25 s movie.
    - **Frame Interpolate** 24 → 48: about half the jitter for a sliver of detail. Under a minute.
    - **RTX Super Resolution**: **deblur** after VOSR2 crisps the edges. 
    - **Film Grain**: 0.25 is a light film texture.
